<robot name="drawer_cabinet_1050x1020x580">
  <!-- Units: metres -->
  <!-- Dimensions -->
  <!-- Cabinet: width 1.05 (X), height 1.02 (Z), depth 0.58 (Y) -->
  <!-- Origin: floor at middle of object: X=0 mid-width, Y=0 at middle depth, Z=0 -->

  <!-- Parameters (conceptual, not URDF math) -->
  <!-- Assumptions:
       - Wall thickness (frame/side/back): 0.018 m
       - Top/bottom thickness: 0.018 m
       - Drawer front thickness: 0.018 m
       - Drawer slides represented as collisions (no articulation)
       - Internal drawer width/height use clearance
  -->

  <!-- Base/outer shell -->
  <link name="base_cabinet">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="35.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.50" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="1.10" iyz="0.0" izz="0.55"/>
    </inertial>
    <!-- Outer box representing the cabinet body -->
    <collision name="outer_shell_collision">
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.05 0.58 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <visual name="outer_shell_visual">
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.51" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.05 0.58 1.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="cabinet_color">
        <color rgba="0.35 0.28 0.20 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <!-- We create 5 drawer links; each drawer slides out along -Y (front is -Y).
       Drawer local reference:
       - Drawer frames are centered in X.
       - Front faces are toward -Y.
       - Cabinet center in Y at 0 with depth 0.58 means:
         Front face at Y = -0.29, back face at Y = +0.29.
       Drawer outer depth (front-to-back of drawer) approximated as 0.54 m to leave clearance.
       Drawer width equals cabinet inner width approximated as 1.05 - 2*0.018 = 1.014 m.
       Drawer height per drawer: (1.02 - 2*top/bottom thickness - 4*gap)/5.
       Use simple stack with equal drawer heights and nominal 0.018 m gaps.
  -->

  <!-- Derived approximate values used consistently:
       top thickness = 0.018
       bottom thickness = 0.018
       gap between drawers = 0.018
       Available internal height = 1.02 - 0.018*2 - 0.018*4 = 1.02 - 0.036 - 0.072 = 0.912
       Drawer height = 0.912 / 5 = 0.1824
       Drawer thickness (side/bottom) represented by a single box for collision/visual.
       Drawer box depth = 0.54
       Drawer box front face at Y = -0.29 + 0.018 + 0.01? (clearance)
       Use drawer box center Y at (back clearance + drawer depth/2) where back clearance is 0.018 + 0.01 = 0.028.
       Then drawer box center Y = +0.29 - 0.028 - 0.54/2 = 0.29 - 0.028 - 0.27 = -0.008
       That places drawer box near centered with a slight bias; acceptable for static URDF.
       Sliding direction: joint axis (0, -1, 0) so positive joint displaces toward -Y.
  -->

  <!-- Drawer dimensions -->
  <!-- drawer_box_size = width 1.014 (X) x depth 0.54 (Y) x height 0.1824 (Z) -->
  <!-- Drawer origin at cabinet center for each drawer: X=0, Y=-0.008 at fully closed position,
       Z positions stacked:
       Z of each drawer box center = bottom thickness + gap + drawer height/2 + (i-1)*(drawer height+gap)
       bottom thickness=0.018, gap=0.018
       center0 (bottom drawer) = 0.018 + 0.018 + 0.1824/2 = 0.036 + 0.0912 = 0.1272
       center1 = 0.1272 + (0.1824+0.018)=0.1272+0.2004=0.3276
       center2 = 0.5280
       center3 = 0.7284
       center4 = 0.9288
  -->

  <!-- Joint limits (meters) -->
  <!-- Assume slide out stroke ~0.25 m -->
  <!-- Fully closed position at joint value 0 -->
  <!-- Joint origin Y at the cabinet closed position, joint axis -Y -->
  <!-- We'll use origin with Z at drawer center; Y at -0.008 to match box center when joint=0. -->

  <!-- Drawer 1 (bottom) -->
  <link name="drawer_1">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0060" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.0135" iyz="0" izz="0.0055"/>
    </inertial>
    <collision name="drawer_1_box_collision">
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.014 0.54 0.1824"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <visual name="drawer_1_box_visual">
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.014 0.54 0.1824"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_color">
        <color rgba="0.70 0.62 0.55 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <!-- Drawer front plate -->
    <collision name="drawer_1_front_collision">
      <origin xyz="0 -0.27 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.014 0.018 0.1824"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <visual name="drawer_1_front_visual">
      <origin xyz="0 -0.27 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.014 0.018 0.1824"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front_color">
        <color rgba="0.65 0.56 0.48 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <joint name="joint_drawer_1" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base_cabinet"/>
    <child link="drawer_1"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.008 0.1272" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.25" effort="200" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Drawer 2 -->

    <visual name="drawer_2_front_visual">

      <geometry>
        <box size="1.014 0.018 0.1824"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front_color"/>
    </visual>
  </link>

    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
